Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 공사판의 사고에 비하면 별거 아니라며 훈련을 다시 하자고 이야기한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> says this is nothing compared to accidents at construction sites, and wants to resume training.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、工事現場の事故に比べれば大したことではないと、トレーニングを再開しようと提案する。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说这跟工地的事故比起来这不算什么，要求继续训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說這跟工地的事故比起來這不算什麼，要求繼續訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dit que ce n'est rien comparé aux accidents sur les chantiers, et veut reprendre l'entraînement.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sagt, das sei nichts im Vergleich zu Unfällen auf Baustellen, und will das Training wieder aufnehmen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dice que esto no es nada comparado con los accidentes en obras de construcción y quiere reanudar el entrenamiento.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> diz que não é nada comparado ao acidente no canteiro de obras e sugere que retomemos o treinamento.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> บอกว่านี่ไม่เท่ากับอุบัติเหตุที่ไซต์ก่อสร้าง และต้องการฝึกต่อ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bilang ini tidak seberapa dibanding kecelakaan di lokasi konstruksi, dan ingin melanjutkan latihan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nói rằng chuyện này chẳng là gì so với tai nạn ở công trường, và muốn tiếp tục tập luyện.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> कहती है कि यह निर्माण स्थलों पर होने वाले हादसों के मुकाबले कुछ भी नहीं है, और वह प्रशिक्षण फिर से शुरू करना चाहती है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 今日はここまでにしよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Lass uns für heute Schluss machen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: วันนี้พอแค่นี้ก่อนนะครับ/คะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Hôm nay chúng ta nghỉ thôi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: चलो आज के लिए बस करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wird es dir wirklich gut gehen…?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: คุณจะโอเคจริง ๆ เหรอครับ/คะ…?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Apa kau benar-benar akan baik-baik saja…?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: क्या तुम सच में ठीक होगे…?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: A donné une Potion de vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ยื่นยาเพิ่มพลังให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa một Bình Thuốc Hoạt Lực.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió detener el entrenamiento y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treinamento e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk menghentikan latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định dừng tập luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'il ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfait.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschlossen hatte, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún parecía insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih tampak tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y logró resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e alcançou resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองอีกครั้งและทำผลงานได้ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> kembali mencoba latihan dan meraih hasil.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại và đạt được kết quả tốt.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम प्राप्त किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a réessayé, mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber wieder.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero falló una vez más.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ลองอีกครั้งแต่ก็ล้มเหลวอีกครั้ง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est illuminé après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดีใจที่ได้รับโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> औषधि मिलने के बाद चमक उठी।
